name: The Norwood Record
notes: Primary dedicated local newspaper; strong Norwood relevance. Separate news from letters, guest columns and press releases where possible.

name: Norwood Public Schools
notes: Official district source. Individual school sections also expose RSS feeds; add selectively to avoid duplicating district items.

name: Town of Norwood
notes: Official notices and substantive public-service updates. Do not treat routine meeting listings as news.

name: CBS Boston / WBZ — Norwood tag
notes: Dedicated Norwood topic page makes this a high-value regional source.

name: Norwood Patch
notes: Useful for local reporting, but exclude Patch AM roundup/filler, promoted businesses, generic statewide stories, Neighbor News without clear Norwood news value, and calendar-only posts.

name: Boston.com — Norwood
notes: Use stories materially about Norwood, not incidental mentions.

name: Norwood Community Media
notes: Local video, meetings and community programming; include substantive news/update items.

name: Inside Norwood
notes: Independent local publication; retain source attribution and deduplicate against primary sources.

name: Friends of Norwood Center
notes: Useful for downtown/community-development news; events should route to What's Happening when appropriate.

name: Google News
notes: Discovery safety net only. Exact Norwood, Massachusetts queries plus geographic rejection and publisher deduplication. Prefer direct publisher URL when recoverable.
